correctness.rationale: Over char3, the Takasaki star is σ(uv) in ordinary group algebra K[(F3)^d]. Frobenius gives u³=ε(u)³1; the equation σ(u)=u² has ε=0 or1, with ε0 forcing u=0 from u=u^4. For ε1, u³=1 and σ(u)=u^{-1}. The anti-invariant augmentation space W has dimension (3^d−1)/2, and w↦1−w−w² is a bijection onto nonzero star-idempotents with inverse u−σ(u), by w³=0. Thus finite-field count 1+q^dim(W). The norm-one group is abelian exponent3 and its core operation equals star, proving nonzero idempotent quandle structure. Independent exhaustive d2,F3 enumeration checked 19,683 vectors and exactly 82 solutions. No associativity of star was improperly assumed.
